capabilities: Add child and sibling nodes from the keyboard while typing
Auto-layout mind map trees and tidy edges with a one-click tidy button
Resize mind map nodes to fit their text with wrapping at a maximum width
Search card text, group labels, links and embedded note content
Copy image nodes and rename pasted images after the canvas
extras: Uses Obsidian's undocumented Canvas internal API and is tested on Obsidian 1.14; interface is available in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: Works on the canvas Obsidian already has; it uses Canvas's internal API
motivation: The author built it because Canvas is a good place to think but mapping in it requires repeated dragging and resizing instead of just typing.
problem: Building a mind map in Obsidian Canvas is slow: you must create each card, drag it into place, drag an edge between cards and resize it by hand.

relations.evidence: the way Paste Image Rename does it for notes

summary: Keyboard mind mapping on Obsidian Canvas: Enter/Tab add connected child and sibling nodes, with auto layout, tidy edges, node auto-sizing and canvas search.
